name: nt-window-title
description: Shows the project name in the status bar and announces it in the editor when the window gains focus, so you can tell your VS Code windows apart

ntWindowTitle.label.description: Name to announce instead of the folder or workspace name. Set this per project (workspace settings) when the folder name is not the name you think in.

ntWindowTitle.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the project name in the status bar.

ntWindowTitle.statusBar.alignment.description: Which end of the status bar the project name sits on.

ntWindowTitle.statusBar.color.markdownDescription: Color of the status-bar project name. Either a hex color (`#22D3EE`) or a theme color id (`terminal.ansiCyan`), which follows the active theme. Anything else falls back to the default.

ntWindowTitle.statusBar.icon.markdownDescription: Codicon name shown before the project name — see the [codicon list](https://microsoft.github.io/vscode-codicons/dist/codicon.html). Leave empty for no icon.

ntWindowTitle.statusBar.flashOnFocus.markdownDescription: Briefly make the badge prominent when the window gains focus, so you notice which project you switched to. Uses `statusBarItem.warningBackground` — one of only two background colors VS Code honours on a status-bar item — so the flash follows your theme rather than a color of our choosing.

ntWindowTitle.statusBar.flashMillisecond.description: How long the flash lasts. Clamped to 200-10000.

ntWindowTitle.editorAnnouncement.enabled.description: Briefly show the project name inside the editor when the window gains focus. Nothing is shown when no text editor is visible, such as on the Welcome tab.

ntWindowTitle.editorAnnouncement.millise.description: How long the announcement stays on screen. Clamped to 200-10000.

ntWindowTitle.editorAnnouncement.color.markdownDescription: Color of the announcement. A hex color or a theme color id such as `terminal.ansiCyan`. Leave empty to reuse `#ntWindowTitle.statusBar.color#` so the badge and the announcement agree.

ntWindowTitle.editorAnnouncement.upperca.description: Render the announced name in capitals.

commands.title: Window Title nt: Announce Project Name
